body:
Greg's standing word (2026-11-27 ~06:17Z, via Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #2930), verbatim: „moga wznawiac sesje jak chca, jak przestana niech utworza nowa i mnie poinformuja” ("they can resume sessions as they want; if they stop, let them create a new one and inform me").
Meaning:
- TermAl and Engram coordinators may resume paused session queues themselves (POST /api/queues/resume-paused with sessionIds, one session at a time, on the host that owns the session) without asking each time.
- If resuming doesn't help, create a new session (POST /api/sessions, same agent, model and project) and INFORM Greg.
- Limits, also from Greg: never work around a provider refusal; report a repeating refusal with its reason; don't move a refused action to another session just to get past the check.
- Still covered by "nobody stops the host": this grants no host restart or kill.
